title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E03 — Bozer + Booze + Back to School
MacGyver and the team go undercover on a college campus to find an operative who is recruiting students to carry out deadly attacks; Jack joins bounty hunter Billy Colton in the hunt for a bail jumper.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S02 E13 — Toxic
The team tracks two brothers who are set on getting revenge against members of the company that caused their town's environmental destruction; Sarah meets the rest of the LaCroix family, including Jess' sister.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S02 E14 — Hustler
The team heads to Washington, D.C., to protect Ortiz's former informant after a hit man tries to kill her; Sarah helps Jess' family prepare for Byron and Marie's last-minute wedding on Jess' farm.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S02 E15 — Chattaboogie
Jubal enlists the help of Jess and his team in tracking down an undercover DEA agent who appears to have turned dirty; Sarah wonders if it was a mistake to move in with Jess and Tali so soon.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E01 — Exposed
A local FBI case involving two murdered women and a sea of powerful men turns into a manhunt for the dangerous leader of a far-reaching criminal enterprise.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E03 — Tough Love
When a judge known for serving harsh sentences to juveniles is murdered, the team looks into his lengthy list of cases in the hunt for his killer; Kristin faces family hurdles while resettling with her teenage daughter in New York City.

title: Bones
description:
S11 E16 — The Strike in the Chord
The team investigates the death of an a cappella singer whose body was found in a lab rat; Hodgins applies for an experimental nerve regeneration study; Booth tries to plan a summer trip with Parker; a new intern joins the lab.

title: Bones
description:
S11 E17 — The Secret in the Service
An intoxicated college student discovers the dead body of a Secret Service agent just before a scheduled presidential visit to the area; former intern Dr. Colin Fisher leads the investigation while Brennan battles a case of the flu.

title: Bones
description:
S11 E18 — The Movie in the Making
A documentary crew producing a television segment on the Jeffersonian's Medico-Legal lab follows the team as it investigates a corpse found in a landfill.

title: Bones
description:
S11 E19 — The Head in the Abutment
Booth's hockey knowledge comes in handy when the team investigates the death of a player whose headless corpse was left in the river; Hodgins and Oliver use drones to see who can retrieve the victim's head.

title: Bones
description:
S11 E20 — The Stiff in the Cliff
The investigation into the murder of a billionaire explorer who went missing 10 years earlier reveals Dr. Clark Edison as a suspect; Cam's sister visits to help with wedding plans.

title: Bones
description:
S11 E21 — The Jewel in the Crown
A diamond is found in the jaw of a corpse discovered at a glass recycling plant; Booth learns that he has a medical issue; Hodgins thinks a ghost is following him.

title: Bones
description:
S11 E22 — The Nightmare in the Nightmare
The team attempts to find The Puppeteer, a serial killer from the past, who lives with his victim's bodies before disposing of them; Brennan struggles with guilt over not stopping the killer earlier.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E01 — The Final Chapter: The Hope in the Horror
Booth and the lab team desperately search for Brennan after she's kidnapped by her former assistant, Zack Addy.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E02 — The Final Chapter: The Brain in the Bot
The team investigates whether an artificial intelligence bot was programmed to kill its creator; Bones plans a surprise for her birthday.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E03 — The Final Chapter: The New Tricks in the Old Dogs
The team becomes enmeshed in retirement home drama when the body of an old man is found in an acid dump site; back at the lab, discussion of marriage and kids dominates the conversation.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E04 — The Final Chapter: The Price for the Past
The team investigates the death of a person from Booth and Brennan's past; Aubrey learns his dad is back in the picture.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E05 — The Final Chapter: The Tutor in the Tussle
When a tutor who works with privileged students turns up dead, the team sifts through possible murderers; Bones wants to voice her own audiobook.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E06 — The Final Chapter: The Flaw in the Saw
The investigation into the murder of a golfer-turned-lumberjack reveals numerous secrets that could have led to the victim's demise, including an affair with a married rival.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E07 — The Final Chapter: The Scare in the Score
Corpses that are linked to Booth's former Army unit turn up around D.C.; Brennan's father hides a serious medical procedure from her.

title: Bones
description:
S12 E08 — The Final Chapter: The Grief and the Girl
A recent loss creates tension between Booth and Brennan as they each try to deal with their grief; an old flame from Brennan's past visits.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E02 — No. 1 Fan
An erratic whistleblower who calls Pride her mentor kidnaps him to help her locate a serial killer targeting young women in the Gulf of Mexico.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E03 — The Asset
The team joins forces with FBI Director Isler after a Russian operative with intelligence on sleeper agents disappears; Tammy partners with former sleeper agent Eva Azarova to assist in the disappearance.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E04 — Dead Man Calling
The team investigates the copycat murder of an unsolved case from 150 years ago that spawned a legendary ghost story; Gregorio is spooked when the case is connected to a recent séance and a local medium.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E05 — Viral
Sebastian is placed on administrative leave after being questioned by the FBI about a foot chase; Pride and the team attempt to clear Sebastian's name.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E07 — The Accident
The team investigates after a clinical trial in which brain implants are put into veterans is hacked; Patton must work alongside his ex-wife, who spearheads the project.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E08 — Sins of the Father
Wade's son asks Pride for help after being attacked and discovering his girlfriend is missing; Pride must meet with a therapist to discuss his process for solving cases.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E09 — Hard Knock Life
Pride starts to doubt evidence suggesting homeless kids murdered a petty officer.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E10 — Mirror, Mirror
Rita Devereaux tells Pride that Douglas Hamilton is about to make a deal to get out of prison; Pride and the team re-investigate the Clearwater case in hopes of spoiling his plans.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E22 — I'Ike Ke Ao
The team races to save an abducted college student from a dangerous vigilante; Max, Kamekona and Flippa struggle to survive after being shipwrecked.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E23 — Pilina Koko
The Five-0 team learns that one of its own has a deep connection to the young daughter of a woman who was murdered in her home.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E24 — Pa'a Ka 'Ipuka i Ka 'Upena Nananana
Five-0 tries to protect a wounded Gabriel and plan an escape when enemy gunmen storm the dilapidated building in which Gabriel is trapped.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E25 — O Ke Ali'I Wale No Ka'u Makemake
McGarrett and Danny pose as drug pilots in a plan to stop a meth epidemic on the island; Danny is forced to break cover and land the plane when McGarrett is seriously wounded.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E01 — Makaukau 'oe e Pa'ani?
The team hunts for a murderer who has been targeting serial killers, marking their corpses with an ivory chess piece.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E02 — No Ke Ali'i Wahine A Me Ka Aina
A rogue MI-6 agent is the key to finding a terrorist who plans to cause the meltdown of nuclear reactors across Europe; McGarrett and Danny need the help of an FBI profiler to find a killer.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E03 — He Moho Hou
After finding a corpse in her bed, FBI profiler Alicia Brown joins McGarrett in a hunt for a killer; Kono reconnects with a former surfing competitor.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E04 — Hu A'e Ke Ahi Lanakila A Kamaile
When the serial killer that Alicia and McGarrett have been hunting kidnaps them, it's up to Five-0 to find them before it's too late.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E05 — Ke Ku 'Ana
A cache of guns is stolen by a person looking to make a statement on gun violence; Kono and Adam are reunited.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E06 — Ka Hale Ho' Okauweli
On Halloween, the team investigates the murder of a medium who was apparently frightened to death by a poltergeist; a mysterious death cult kidnaps Kono and Adam.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E07 — Ka Makuahine A Me Ke Keikikane
Catherine informs Five-0 that McGarrett's mother has been captured and is in danger of being executed for trying to free Wo Fat's imprisoned father; Chin is unable to delay Sara's adoption.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E08 — Hana Komo Pae
While Danny chaperones Grace's high school dance, the venue is seized by terrorists, who hold everyone hostage with the intent of abducting a diplomat's son; Danny and Grover discover that Will is Grace's secret boyfriend.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E09 — Elua La Ma Nowemapa
A conspiracy theorist with compelling information that JFK's own cabinet planned his assassination is murdered.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E10 — Ka Luhi
A boy suffering from PTSD undergoes hypnosis and realizes he may have witnessed a murder related to a 10-year-old cold case; Danny's sister visits Oahu.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E11 — Ka'ili Aku
The team rushes to Mexico, where Chin puts his life in jeopardy in an effort to rescue Sara, his kidnapped niece.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S07 E12 — Ka 'aelike
When Chin is kidnapped by a Mexican cartel, Five-0 must rescue him before he is executed by the vengeful group; Grover goes undercover to investigate a murder, which turns out to be far more complex and dangerous than anticipated.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E03 — Curtain Call
A performer's life is threatened, so Toby poses as her assistant and helps to investigate.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E04 — The Taking
An African teenager, whose father is an alleged war criminal, is abducted.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E05 — Rogues' Gallery
Toby's telepathy acts as surveillance when Michelle goes undercover to expose an art-theft ring.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E06 — She Sells Sanctuary
Toby and Michelle investigate the connection between a cult and three missing young women.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E16 — Laissez les Bon Temps Rouler
On the eve of his wedding to Rita -- and Connor leaving for the Witness Protection Program -- Pride must track down who attacked Jimmy and Connor, while he navigates Sasha's ulterior motives regarding her son.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E01 — Musician Heal Thyself
The team investigates the death of a petty officer whom Pride had mentored; Brody searches for a place to call home.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E02 — Carrier
When a Navy lieutenant on liberty dies of bubonic plague, NCIS Special Agent Tony DiNozzo helps the New Orleans team as they try to control a potential outbreak and find the source of the infectious disease.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E03 — Breaking Brig
An armored transport bus crashes, resulting in the escape of four prisoners -- including a black market broker topping the list of national security threats; Pride needs Gibbs' help with a case file full of redactions.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E04 — The Recruits
When a Navy SEAL is found dead in a sorority house, the team must determine if his death was related to collegiate foul play or a classified mission; Pride's daughter visits the office.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E05 — It Happened Last Night
The investigation into a chief warrant officer's death reveals that his wife has been abducted -- leaving the team with a 22-hour deadline; senior FBI agent Fornell assists with the case.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E06 — Master of Horror
Amidst Halloween festivities in New Orleans, a Naval Staff Judge Advocate dressed in a costume is found dead in a cemetery; the team debates Halloween costumes and activities.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E07 — Watch Over Me
The team investigate the murder of a Navy Officer assigned as a tech liaison with a private developer; Pride turns the carport into an auto shop.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E08 — Love Hurts
A murdered petty officer -- with a proposal and an engagement ring -- is found in a Mardi Gras float storage facility; the members of the team are baffled when they cannot locate the victim's girlfriend.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E09 — Chasing Ghosts
The team reopens a cold case when a stolen Navy-issue gun turns out to belong to a chief petty officer who died 40 years ago; the team makes their annual Thanksgiving dinner together.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E10 — Stolen Valor
A retired SEAL -- who tracked people impersonating military personnel -- is murdered; Brody finds that LaSalle is uncharacteristically unenthusiastic about Christmas.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E11 — Baitfish
The investigation into an explosion at the Navy-Marine Corp Relief Gala reveals Pride was the bomb's target.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E12 — The Abyss
The NCIS team and the Coast Guard Investigative Service work together when a Navy Admiral's daughter is the prime suspect in a double murder on a research boat; LaSalle looks for his estranged brother.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E13 — The Walking Dead
After learning, he was poisoned with a deadly dose of radiation, a Navy lieutenant commander asks Pride and the team to solve his imminent murder.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E14 — Careful What You Wish For
An agent is killed while working on a security detail for the Vice Chief of Naval Operations; Brody's past is evaluated.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E15 — Le Carnivale de la Mort
A petty officer is murdered during Mardi Gras festivities; Pride contemplates what to tell his daughter about his strained relationship with his father.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E16 — My Brother's Keeper
The NCIS team tries to narrow down the motive when a Navy recruiter is murdered in a hit-and-run; LaSalle worries about his brother.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E17 — More Now
Pride believes Baitfish has returned and has the NCIS team chase down leads in an attempt to locate him.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E18 — The List
When a sailor is killed in a strip club, the murder weapon turns out to be linked to other unsolved cases; Brody receives a visit from her ex-fiance.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E19 — The Insider
During the autopsy of a petty officer who seems to have died of natural causes, an armed man holds Wade, Sebastian and Danny hostage in the morgue.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E04 — Inherited
The team must determine if the kidnapping of a young Chinese-American woman is a random hate crime or if she was specifically targeted; Jess and Sarah struggle with Tali's continued rebellious streak.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E04 — Callisto
While helping a young woman fight a drug patent lawsuit, the team must travel to the small Texas town where Bull experienced the only trial loss of his career.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E05 — Just Tell the Truth
Bull defends the working class fiancé of a murdered socialite; Marissa, Cable and Danny ask Chunk to let them investigate a new guy he wants to date.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E06 — Bedside Manner
Bull has to find a way to reverse the negative effect of a surgeon with a God complex who is being sued for malpractice; Bull hires a previous client's attorney.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E09 — Ke Koho Mamao Aku
When a cowboy is poisoned, Max must work with a rival medical examiner; McGarrett wants Danny to steal a Christmas tree.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E10 — Wawahi moe'uhane
An old-school private detective helps the Five-0 solve the murder of a young woman who secretly worked as an escort.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E11 — Ua'aihue
When a tourist unknowingly transporting a stolen Van Gogh is murdered, Kono and Chin go undercover into the world of black market art; McGarrett asks chef Masaharu Morimoto to train Kamekona for a shrimp cook-off.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E12 — Poina 'ole
When a neurosurgeon is murdered right before a procedure, the stunning truth about a decades-old disappearance of four school boys is revealed; McGarrett's car is stolen.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E13 — La Po'ino
A patient with a contagious and deadly strain of bird flu is kidnapped -- and the people responsible plan to weaponize the virus.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E14 — Powehiwehi
Kono must fight for her life after discovering a notorious criminal's identity; Adam's ties to his formerly corrupt family business leave Kono feeling concerned.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E15 — E 'Imi Pono
The members of the Five-0 investigate a journalist's past after he is killed; as Valentine's Day draws near, a text mix-up causes Danny to overreact.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E16 — Nanahu
Five-0 and an ATF agent (Melina Kanakaredes) from California team up when a serial arsonist targets couples in Oahu; Amber's abusive ex tracks her down while she is on a romantic getaway with Danny.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E17 — Kuka'awale
Danny and McGarrett work on their relationship as they pursue a woman who escaped after a diamond robbery.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E18 — Pono Kaulike
When Chin and Danny are taken into custody over past deadly transgressions, McGarrett turns to Joe for help.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E19 — Kahania
McGarrett and Odell come under assault at the barbershop while trying to protect a young man being hunted by a gang; Jerry is accused of a series of home invasions.
